questions: Should the removal of rows based on tuples consider only the columns in COLUMNS, or all columns in the DataFrame?
If the DataFrame has fewer than 2 columns after removal, should the function still attempt to generate plots?
Are the tuples for row removal expected to match the entire row (all columns) or just a subset of columns?
Should the random column pairs be sampled without replacement across the generated plots, i.e., no column appears in more than one pair?
If n_plots is negative, should the function raise an error, treat as zero, or handle differently?
Should the function modify the input DataFrame in-place or return a new DataFrame?
If the DataFrame is empty after removal, should the function return an empty list of plots or handle gracefully?
Should the random sampling of columns use a fixed seed for reproducibility, or be truly random each time?
